segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin say the treatment helps control excess oil and leaves skin feeling tighter and smoother without the dryness they might expect from an AHA exfoliant.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report the treatment hydrates rather than strips, though several recommend dry-skin users stick to once a week with a good moisturizer afterward to avoid over-drying.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including one whose skin shifts from oily to dry, say the treatment is moisturizing and non-stripping while still helping control oil and reduce breakouts.
segments.sensitive: The great majority of reviewers with sensitive or easily irritated skin report the treatment doesn't sting, burn, or break them out even with regular use, though several say it's genuinely strong for sensitive skin and caution using it only once a week or with a very light hand to avoid irritation.
segments.normal: The one reviewer who describes her skin as normal, not particularly dry or oily, reports brightening and a lightweight, hydrating feel with once-weekly use.

concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers, including some with dry or peeling skin from retinol use, say the treatment hydrates and leaves skin feeling plump and soft rather than dry or stripped; a few, however, say it isn't very nourishing on its own or that over-application dried and even burned their skin, and recommend a lighter hand plus moisturizer afterward.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers say the treatment reduces existing redness around the nose or overall, and one who normally reacts to exfoliants with pink, irritated skin says this one didn't cause that; one reviewer, however, did notice slight redness after her first uses that faded with continued use.
concerns.spots: Multiple reviewers report dark spots, discoloration, and post-acne marks lightening with a few weeks of regular use; one reviewer notes she doesn't have significant hyperpigmentation so can't speak to that specific benefit.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers, including several dealing with hormonal, mask-related, or picked-at acne, report fewer breakouts, faster-healing blemishes, and fading acne scars with regular use, and none in this set report the treatment causing new breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin say the treatment helps control excess oil and leaves skin feeling less oily without over-drying it.

extraits.texte: i used this product twice a week and yes, i did feel a mild stinging sensation (not bad at all) and yes, it was soothing and hydrating... however, i didn't see any drastic outstanding results that would make me highly recommend this product to a friend.

I used this toner twice a week for a few weeks straight and did notice smoother and less oily skin. I've been more oily especially in the summer and I felt like this toner helped control my oils. It tingles lightly when applied and I would recommend using it sparingly and with a light hand. I think I applied too much pressure when swiping it across my skin at one point and I did end up stripping some skin and burning my cheek a bit. I stopped using the toner for a week in that specific area to let my skin heal and just continued use more gently. My skin feels tighter, smoother, and less oily.

After about two weeks of trial with the product, I did notice some brightening of my skin the next morning after I used the product. My skin is normal (not necessarily dry or oily) and sensitive so I used this product at night and only once a week considering the high concentration of AHA. The toner itself is pretty lightweight and loose as well as hydrating. I appreciate the different amounts and weights of derivatives of hyaluronic acid that balances out the treatment well. Keep in mind this product was gifted to me, but I enjoyed it nevertheless.

I have combination skin that shifts from oily to dry very quickly and suffer from acne here and there. I found this to be moisturizing and non-stripping and kept oil at bay. It also minimized the redness around my nose and helped even my skintone over a 2 week morning+ every other night day routine. Ingredients are also amazing with no fragrance and fillers.

After cleansing face, I apply a few dabs on a cotton pad and gently wipe skin. After the tingly feeling goes away, I apply eye cream and moisturizer. Sometimes I use my serum drops before moisturizer. I only use it 2x a week (DIRECTIONS SAY ONLY USE 1 or 2x a week). Ever since I started using this product, I have not been breaking out. I started noticing that glass skin effect and my pores have gotten noticeably smaller. My skin is very sensitive; therefore, I was hesitant to try this but now it is part of my daily routine. I have used this product for about a month. On the days that I don't use this product, I use a facial mist instead of a toner. *If you have super dry skin, I would use it only once a week and apply a lot of moisturizer and serum after.

Super hydrating and perfect for my sensitive skin. Great for winter months where my skin has a hard time exfoliating on its own! I usually have super dry skin and this didn't bother my skin at all. I'd definitely add this on my skin regimen!

extraits.titre: I would buy and recommend this product!
extraits.texte: I use this product 1x-2x a week. If you plan to use it in the morning, be sure to follow up with your typical serums, moisturizer and sunscreen! At night time, follow it up with your serums and night time moisturizer. Worked really well for me and have noticed my blemish scars have lightened up within 2 weeks or so.
